considered_options: Option 1: Inverted File Index with Flat Quantization (IVFFLAT)
Option 2: Hierarchical Navigable Small World Graphs (HNSW)
architecture_decision_records.context_and_problem_statement: The cognitive pipeline requires high-throughput semantic similarity search over embeddings with p99 latency < 10ms.
architecture_decision_records.decision_outcome: Adopt HNSW due to superior logarithmic search complexity and high recall on 1024-dim dense vectors.
negative_consequences: Increased RAM footprint during index construction (~1.5x of raw vectors)
positive_consequences: Sub-5ms search latency across 100k embedded vectors
High recall (>98%) without lossy scalar quantization
architecture_decision_records.title: Selection of HNSW Vector Index for Sub-Millisecond In-Memory Retrieval
